title: A lovely morning of culture and history.
text: The tour was excellent. The Alhambra and it's story is complex. Gaby tied all of the pieces together in a way that we could never have done for ourselves. We were left with a lot of insight into the society and culture of the times and a curiosity to know more. We would love to do it all over again.
author: jimfK3689KH

title: Had the HIGHEST Expectations and she EXCEEDED them!!
text:
For 3 years, I have been dreaming of visiting the Alhambra and was seeking the private tour of tours.  

Gabby was UNBELIEVABLE...she exceeded my exceedingly high expectations.  We LEARNED and ENJOYED the experience on levels that were truly exceptional.

Gabby's knowledge and ease of discussion of the entire areas was truly amazing.  She is a TRUE gem!!

And then we enjoyed lunch at a local tavern that made the best experience even better.  Whatever you pay her it is not enough!

Eternal thanks!!!

title: Recommend without reserve
text: Our guide was excellent. Respectful of our needs, knew the tricks to manage the crowds, detailed explanations, but not too much, just the right balance.

title: Amazing experience
text: Gaby was helpful from the time we booked the tour.  I had no idea we had to buy the tickets well in advance.  The was extremely knowledgeable and made the tour very interning.  What an amazing place!
author: Ivanna_V

title: Off the Beaten Path
text:
Gaby provided us with a great tour of the Alhambra, providing just the right amount of history and inside information.  The pace was perfect and she knew how to stay away from the worst of the crowds.

But where she really excelled was her tour of the Albaicin.  Because we had already spent a fair amount of time exploring this area on our own, we really needed her to take us to some hidden spots -- special places off the beaten path where 99% of the tourists don't see or know about.  She completely delivered.  She showed us the most beautiful door we have ever seen, anywhere in the world!  Als

title: Amazing visit
text: There's nothing better than a visit with an Alhambra lover. We knew we would love the Alhambra but seeing it through the eyes of Isabel Gonzalez, our guide, was an unforgettable experience. A great professional and beautiful person. Of course if we come back we'll count on her.
